Our story, from Pandamaran to Bukit Tinggi

A Klang bak kwa name with Pandamaran roots.

Hock Chuan Hiong started at a stall in Pandamaran: Gerai 106, Jalan Besar.

The sign over our counter reads 1996年老字号, a name in bak kwa since 1996.

Today our shop is at Lorong Batu Nilam 1D in Bandar Bukit Tinggi 1, Klang, open every day.

Ben Gor’s 我的 Pandamaran 童年美食

On our Facebook page, Ben Gor (Ben哥) presents 我的 Pandamaran 童年美食, a food-story series about the Pandamaran food he grew up with. 35 episodes so far.
